name: half-kneeling-cable-lift
instructions:
1. Assume a half kneeling position and attach a rope to a cable stack at the lowest position possible.
2. Position the inside knee down and set up with both hands grasping the ends of the rope.
3. Pull the rope to chest height and then press diagonally overhead.
4. Return to the starting position, repeat for the desired number of repetitions, and then switch sides.
